assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent PNG vehicle artwork for a Korean automotive app. Generate a single premium photorealistic silver Korean executive sedan, similar in proportions to a 2020 Hyundai Grandeur, viewed in exact orthographic top-down bird's-eye view. Hood at the TOP, trunk at BOTTOM, front windshield at upper third, dark charcoal panoramic roof with subtle silver frame, rear windscreen and short sedan trunk visible. Four closed doors, side mirrors, fine chrome trim, crisp realistic silver paint gradients from soft studio lights. Elegant long sedan body, not SUV, no roof rails. Entire car fits with only 4% transparent margin on all sides, vertical portrait composition, car aligned exactly straight and symmetrical. The asset must be real transparent alpha outside vehicle with only a faint tight realistic ground shadow. Ultra high quality 3D product rendering, smooth anti-aliased clean silhouette, photographic materials. No labels, no text, no UI, no control buttons, no glowing points, no rings, no platform. This is a standalone illustrative car asset matching the realistic overhead car in a premium vehicle control app.
